response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), with_total AS (SELECT powerstatus, count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as total FROM status_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, count, total, CAST(count AS FLOAT) / CAST(total AS FLOAT) as share FROM with_total), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_avg_statuses AS (SELECT ws.powerstatus, ws.count, ws.share, asc.avg_share FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE ws.share > asc.avg_share) SELECT SUM(count) as total_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as how_far_above FROM above_avg_statuses
